description: Typed error categories shared by all boundaries (M0-E01-S01 draft). Messages never include secrets, raw host output or internal paths.

validation.description: Request is malformed or violates a documented constraint.

unauthenticated.description: No valid session or peer credential.

forbidden.description: Authenticated but not permitted; deny by default.

not_found.description: Resource absent or not visible to the caller (no existence leak).

conflict.description: Generation mismatch or idempotency-key reuse with different payload.

prohibited.description: Request falls in a prohibited category (see prohibited.json).

unavailable.description: A dependency (agent, libvirt, store) is unavailable.

timeout.description: A dependency did not answer within its deadline; outcome may be unknown.

host_error.description: Host or hypervisor reported a failure for a typed command.

internal.description: Unexpected server fault; details only in redacted logs.
